title: Data Representation knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Data Representation”?
options: The method removes the need to inspect data quality or define an evaluation strategy.
The method always performs better than a simple baseline, regardless of the task.

Data Representation is part of Data Preprocessing and Feature Transformation. Define the task, inspect the inputs, choose a simple reference approach, and test the result on representative examples before drawing conclusions.
The method proves that every prediction will be correct on all future datasets.
questions.answer_key: Data Representation is part of Data Preprocessing and Feature Transformation. Define the task, inspect the inputs, choose a simple reference approach, and test the result on representative examples before drawing conclusions.
questions.explanation: The lesson frames the topic this way: Data Representation is part of Data Preprocessing and Feature Transformation. Define the task, inspect the inputs, choose a simple reference approach, and test the result on representative examples before drawing conclusions. The other options make unsupported guarantees.

questions.prompt: What is a sound first step when applying “Data Representation” to a new task?
options: Assume the default parameters are best for every dataset.
Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for Dense versus sparse matrices; then test it on representative data.
Tune against the final test set until the preferred metric increases.
Remove records that produce unexpected outcomes without investigating them.
questions.answer_key: Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for Dense versus sparse matrices; then test it on representative data.
questions.explanation: Define the input, output, assumptions, and evidence needed. For Dense versus sparse matrices, a small representative check is more useful than blind tuning.

questions.prompt: What conclusion is appropriately cautious after trying “Data Representation”?
options: A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
A single successful run proves fairness, robustness, and production readiness.
A higher training score alone proves generalization to unseen data.
An internal estimator score replaces domain review and operational monitoring.
questions.answer_key: A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
questions.explanation: A demonstration only supports conclusions within its scope. Evaluate representative unseen cases and report limitations before production use.
